text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Use Playwright MCP to drive EXCAVA’s interface live. This keeps the screen action visible, immediate, and testable without human clicks, maximizing clarity and speed. The trade-off is locking the demo to a single browser engine, but that’s acceptable because EXCAVA’s interface is simple and Playwright’s engine is fast and reliable.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Playwright MCP locks us to one browser engine, but EXCAVA’s interface might break in subtle ways on others—silent failures that only surface in production. A safer alternative is to run Playwright against a headless Chrome *and* Firefox in CI, logging visual diffs; that settles the argument by proving cross-browser consistency without sacrificing visibility.
